name: Large Medium Vessel Vasculitis Long Case

reference.source: Long Cases in Clinical Medicine (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Granulomatous large-vessel inflammation blinds the elderly through temporal arteritis and starves young limbs through Takayasu stenoses; PAN beads medium vessels with hep-B aneurysms and neuropathy while Kawasaki reddens the young heart with coronary aneurysms.
additionalDifferentials: Atherosclerosis versus fibromuscular versus infective versus amyloid by age beads cultures and fragility
GCA versus Takayasu by age jaw-limb pattern and biopsy
PAN versus Kawasaki by age hep-B coronaries and mucosa
additionalInvestigations: Temporal biopsy halo with ESR CRP
Angiography stenosis maps with four-limb pulses
Hep-B Kawasaki echo with TB screens
